# Talnt AI

> Talnt AI helps small and medium businesses adopt AI without hiring an IT department. Three offers: a $197 AI Workflow Audit, AI Front Desk (a 24/7 AI phone & text agent starting at $297/mo), and a $2,000 one-time Full AI Setup built inside ChatGPT, Perplexity, or Claude.

Talnt AI is a sister company to [Talnt Staffing](https://talntstaffing.com), which provides human staffing for the work AI can't or shouldn't handle.

## Offers

- [AI Front Desk](https://www.talntai.com/ai-front-desk.html): An AI agent that answers calls and texts 24/7, texts back missed calls, books appointments, and requests reviews. Starter $297/mo, Growth $497/mo, one-time $750 setup.
- [Full AI Setup](https://www.talntai.com/ai-setup.html): A persistent AI assistant built on a business — a context pack, a custom GPT, and task-specific tools inside ChatGPT, Perplexity, or Claude. $2,000 one-time.
- [Pricing](https://www.talntai.com/pricing.html): Side-by-side comparison of all three offers.

## Industries served

- [Home & trade services](https://www.talntai.com/industries/home-trade-services.html) (plumbers, HVAC, electricians, landscapers)
- [Salons & spas](https://www.talntai.com/industries/salons.html)
- [Auto repair shops](https://www.talntai.com/industries/auto-repair.html)
- [Print shops](https://www.talntai.com/industries/print-shops.html) (also covers print workflow automation, not just phone answering)
- [Ecommerce sellers](https://www.talntai.com/industries/ecommerce.html)
- [Wholesale distributors](https://www.talntai.com/industries/wholesale.html)
